title: Homepage focus reset: adaptive primary CTA, guest hero, calm reading strip

spec.problem: HomepageClient currently mounts 4 tabs (HomepageSectionsTabs), competing task/gamification widgets, and a mid-page AdSlot above content, while TodayPlanHub renders a static /levels primary CTA, shows an empty 0-stat dashboard to guests, omits ?tab=review on due-review links, links remediation to Career RPG (/review-inbox-preview), omits a /scenarios action, and duplicates global search in a Tra cứu nhanh snapshot row.

acceptance.text: AC1: Signed-out TodayPlanHub (isLoggedIn=false) renders a BJT workplace positioning hero with primary CTA to /{locale}/levels, secondary register/login links, and a 3-step core-loop summary, with no zero-stat strip and no snapshot aside.

AC2: Signed-in TodayPlanHub adapts the primary hero CTA to /{locale}/flashcards?tab=review when dueReviews > 0 and /{locale}/quiz (with secondary /{locale}/levels link) when dueReviews === 0, wires action cards to /{locale}/flashcards?tab=review, /{locale}/quiz mistake review, and /{locale}/scenarios (removing /review-inbox-preview), and omits the redundant Tra cứu nhanh SnapshotRow.

AC3: HomepageClient unmounts HomepageSectionsTabs (keeping files on disk), renders one compact reading strip of up to 3 NHK Easy cards plus a view-all link to /{locale}/news, and renders AdSlot below the reading strip while preserving OnboardingFlow and PushPromptBanner.

AC4: Minimal i18n keys are added to messages/{vi,en,ja}.json and HomepageLabels; unit tests in today-plan-hub.test.tsx and homepage-client.test.tsx cover guest and signed-in contracts, and verify-frontend passes with zero new lint/test/contrast debt.

spec.expected_behavior: Signed-out visitors get a focused BJT positioning hero (1 primary CTA to /{locale}/levels, secondary register/login links, 3-step core-loop summary, no stat strip or snapshot aside); signed-in learners get an adaptive primary hero CTA (/{locale}/flashcards?tab=review when dueReviews > 0, else /{locale}/quiz with secondary /{locale}/levels link), 2 calm action cards plus scenarios entry without /review-inbox-preview, and a clean snapshot aside without Tra cứu nhanh; HomepageClient unmounts HomepageSectionsTabs, renders one compact <=3-card NHK Easy reading strip with /{locale}/news link, and places AdSlot below the reading strip.
spec.observed_behavior: Signed-out visitors see 0-stat counters and no value proposition; signed-in learners with due reviews still get a static /levels hero CTA and a /flashcards link without ?tab=review; Card 2 links to /review-inbox-preview; TodayPlanHub aside renders a redundant Tra cứu nhanh row; HomepageClient mounts HomepageSectionsTabs and places AdSlot above the content section.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert apps/web/app/[locale]/_components/homepage/{homepage-client,today-plan-hub,types}* and the new homepage keys in apps/web/messages/{vi,en,ja}.json; unmounted homepage components remain on disk untouched.

classification.rationale: Learner homepage focus reset in apps/web (TodayPlanHub guest/adaptive hero, action cards, reading strip, AdSlot ordering, and i18n copy) with no API, DB, auth, or component file deletions.
